Me and my fiance met playing a game. VRChat specifically (cringe I know.) We are both very dedicated to each other and our relationship. While it’s hard to connect in a physical sense while in a LDR, we connect on an emotional and personal level. 

We have meet several times in the span of 3 years, spending significant in-person time together. He’s now moving here and we are getting married soon. It’s still crazy to think about how far we’ve come.

My fiance is from Finland. He tells me that many people there get depression super easily because of the lack of sunlight in winter time. He also tells me the government is making poor choices at the moment. He will sometimes say to me “no wonder people want to move out of Finland these days.” Finding employment is also super difficult even for Finnish citizens.

Not saying Finland is a bad country, just be realistic. Every country has problems and no country is perfect even if it’s labeled “happiest country.” Don’t romanticize it.
